capabilities: define filter sets of notes by filename, pathname or tags with regex support
open a note from a set via the Pick note command or per-set commands
choose notes with flat or recursive pickers that handle folder structure
expose an API so other plugins can query filter sets and reuse setting inputs
extras: Warns that emoji or special characters in Filter Set names can cause commands to be merged after normalisation and can break referencing sets by name from other plugins; attributions note code reused from other projects.
problem: Obsidian's built-in quick switcher and search do not let you save named sets of notes (matched by filename, path or tags, including regex) and open a note from a specific set via a command or hotkey.

relations.evidence: The core of the API was developed for the Local Template Configuration Plugin which was then extended

summary: Opens notes and folders chosen from user-defined filter sets matched by filename, path or tags, with flat or recursive pickers and per-set commands.
